ValidationRule.description: For billable tasks, reported progress may not deviate from actual/estimated hours by more than a status- and severity-based tolerance.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( Is_Billable__c, NULLVALUE(Estimated_Hours__c, 0) > 0, NOT(ISBLANK(Progress__c)), ABS(Progress__c - MIN(1, NULLVALUE(Actual_Hours__c, 0) / MAX(0.01, NULLVALUE(Estimated_Hours__c, 0)))) > IF(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Blocked'), 0.75, CASE(TEXT(Severity__c), 'Blocker', 0.3, 'Major', 0.4, 0.5)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Progress deviates too far from the hours burned.
